Summary of a Fitted gwasAim Model

Source: R/summary.gwasAim.R
summary.gwasAim.Rd

Produces a summary table of significant markers detected by gwasAim, sorted by chromosome and cM position.

The table contains chromosome, marker name, cM position, estimated additive effect, p-value, percentage of phenotypic variance explained, and (optionally) a LOD score column. Returns NULL invisibly (with a message) when no significant markers were detected.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gwasAim'
summary(object, genObj, LOD = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted object of class "gwasAim", as returned by gwasAim.

genObj

The "wgPanel" object used in the original gwasAim call, produced by primePanel. Required to resolve marker names and cM positions.

LOD

Logical. If TRUE (default), a LOD score column is appended to the summary table. LOD is computed as \(0.5 \log_{10}(\exp(z^2))\).

...

Currently unused.

Value

A data.frame with one row per significant marker and columns Chromosome, Marker, dist(cM), Size, Pvalue, Perc.Var, and optionally LOD (6 or 7 columns univariate). For multivariate models a leading Trait column is prepended (7 or 8 columns), with rows repeated once per trial level for each detected marker. Returns NULL invisibly if no markers were detected.

See also

gwasAim, print.gwasAim, aimTrace, getQTL

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# After running gwasAim():
summary(gwas.fit, genObj = panel)
summary(gwas.fit, genObj = panel, LOD = FALSE)
} # }
